title: Token auth middleware
tagline: The admin page is open to everyone, every token looks expired, any signature passes, and demoted admins keep their powers.
lookFor: Express runs things in order. A route written ABOVE `app.use(auth)` skips the login check.
Token `exp` is in SECONDS. `Date.now()` is in ms.
A signature check must COMPARE the two signatures, not just check one exists.
Read roles from the database, not from the token.

hints: Is the admin route above or below `app.use(auth)`?
bugs.cause: The route is set up before the login check, so it never gets checked.

bugs.symptom: Every valid token is rejected as expired
bugs.cause: A ms number is always bigger than a seconds number, so every token looks expired.

bugs.symptom: A token edited to role=admin is accepted
bugs.cause: It only checks both exist, so any signature passes.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: Demoted admin still gets admin access
bugs.cause: The role comes from the token, which still says 'admin' after a demotion.
bugs.fix: Load the user by `payload.sub` and use the database role (401 if they're gone).
